newsitem.title: UK: Berisford says current year sales higher.
newsitem.headline: Berisford says current year sales higher.

text.p: Berisford Plc said on Friday its sales and orders for the first seven weeks of its current financial year were higher compared to its performance in the previous year.
The consumer food equipment to agribusiness firm said its sales and orders at its unit Welbilt were up one and eight percent respectively.
It said its sales at Magnet were up 11 percent, retail kitchen orders were up 19 percent while kitchen sales despatched from its Darlington factory in northeast England rose eight percent.
The company also reported a slight dip in its pretax profit for the year ending September 28, 1996 to 25.5 million stg from 26.8 million in the previous year.
"In addition, Welbilt's new product launches have been well received with a $7 million order for our new universal holding cabinet from a major customer," the company said in its statement.
